name: Guard Jagdish
dialogue: Namaste, new student! Welcome to the Central / Main Campus of University of Hyderabad.
Head north into the Administration Building (Pin 36) or Admission Office (Pin 37) for document verification.
Checkpoints connect you to West Campus (left road), East Campus (right avenue), and South Campus (south avenue)!

name: Senior Scholar Ananya
dialogue: Hey there, fresher! Congratulations on getting admitted to UoH!
Tip from a senior: Always keep your Campus Discovery Book handy (press 'J'). Every time you find a building, lake, or rock, you earn exploration points!
You can cross road checkpoints to explore the other 3 campus sections anytime!

name: Prof. Sharma
dialogue: Welcome to the School of Computer and Information Sciences (SCIS) - Pin 45!
We build world-class AI models, distributed networks, and quantum algorithms here.
Step inside our interactive lab classroom anytime (press E) to test your skills in the 5-question CS pop quiz!

name: Librarian Radhika
dialogue: Welcome to the Indira Gandhi Memorial Library (Pin 51).
We house over 400,000 reference volumes, scholarly journals, and digital research databases.
Step inside to enjoy peaceful study reading or take our campus heritage quiz!

name: Prof. Manjula Sridharan
dialogue: Greetings! Welcome to South Campus, home to the School of Life Sciences (Pin 3) and ASPIRE BioNEST (Pin 2).
Our bio-incubators and genetic research labs are recognized globally for biotechnology innovations.
Follow SLS Road east to reach the Centre for Integrated Studies (Pin 5) and the South Hostels quads!

name: Warden Murali
dialogue: Welcome to MHK Hostel (Pin 13) on South Campus!
Your student dorm room is ready inside. Press E to enter your room whenever you need to sleep and restore your stamina.
The South Shopping Complex (Pin 9) and Volleyball Court (Pin 16) are located at the west end of SLS Road.

name: Guard Balram
dialogue: Welcome to West Campus!
This section houses the Indoor Stadium & Gymnasium (Pin 30), Central Workshop (Pin 73), IDC Building (Pin 76), and India Post (Pin 74).
Take the East Checkpoint gate to travel to Main Campus, or the South Trail to reach the scenic Check Dam!

name: Coach Vikram
dialogue: Great to see you at the Indoor Stadium & Gymnasium (Pin 30)!
A healthy body fosters a sharp mind. We have badminton courts, fitness gyms, and table tennis arenas.
Run laps across the stadium track to build up your stamina!

name: Raju Bhai
dialogue: Bhaiya! Welcome to Sukoon Canteen (Pin 59) on East Campus!
When evening sets in and night falls, we serve the crispiest samosas, hot Irani chai, and spicy Maggi.
Scholars from Chemistry, Mathematics, and Arts & Communication gather here every evening!

name: Guard Shankar
dialogue: Welcome to the East Campus entrance (Pin 41)!
Head west along this avenue to reach Chemistry, CR Rao Institute of Mathematics (Pin 62), and the Arts studios.
Karthik Xerox and Sim cards (Pin 42) is right here for all your printouts.

name: Warden Sreenivas
dialogue: Welcome to Amphi Valley! This scenic corridor connects North/Main Campus and South Campus.
Here you'll find the iconic stepped Amphitheatre (Pin 21), Amphi Lake (Pin 20), and Secret Lake (Pin 22).
Follow the north-east road to reach Administration & Library, or the south-west road to reach the School of Life Sciences!

name: Ranger Arjun
dialogue: Greetings traveler! You've arrived at the Check Dam Wetland Basin (Pin 1).
This natural buffer zone catches rainfall cascading down the granite ridges, nurturing biodiversity across campus.
Explore Globbo Rock (Pin 17) and Chinna Gudi Temple (Pin 18) perched on the rocky plateau!
